subject: chemistry
content: An organic compound C<sub>x</sub>H<sub>2y</sub>O<sub>y</sub> was burnt with twice the amount of oxygen needed for complete combustion of CO<sub>2</sub> and H<sub>2</sub>O. The hot gases when cooled to 0<sup>o</sup>C and 1 atm pressure, measured 2.24 litres. The water collected during cooling weighed 0.9 g. The vapour pressure of pure water at 20<sup>o</sup>C is 17.5 mm Hg and is lowered by 0.104 mm when 50 g of the organic compound are dissolved in 1000 g of water. Give the molecular formula of the organic compound.
